events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Liam Gallagher, the voice of a generation, still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite LG track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975. The album of the same name was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message, an unforgettable song. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you could carry '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod was unveiled 25 years ago this month, changing music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Shirley Bassey to Billie Eilish, which Bond theme song gets your vote for the ultimate 007 anthem?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: A true icon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Silly walks and laughs
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is simply timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary sound
angles.copy: More than five decades on, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a masterpiece of musical diversity. What's your standout track from this legendary record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true icon. Freddie Mercury's voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to shine brightly. What's your favourite Queen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Evolution of sound
angles.copy: A masterpiece turns 61! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game, showcasing new depths in songwriting. Which track defines the album for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Forty-six years ago today, on December 8, 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Peace and music
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we honour John Lennon. His vision for peace and his timeless music resonate as strongly as ever.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary innovator, David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman's legacy
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today. Born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to Elvis Presley! His voice, his moves, his legacy – forever iconic. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar god
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young! Wishing a very happy birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page, the architect of some of rock's most iconic riffs. What's your favourite Pagey moment?
